paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者喜欢米白组合里一枚小圆扣，却不想把整套衣服变成粉色；换成同样大小的蓝色圆点后，仍喜欢那一点玩心。吸引力可能来自形状、尺度或留白，不必同时认同所有颜色。可以只想象，不能由这个偏好推断年龄、甜美性格或五官。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader likes one small round fastening against cream but wants no pink outfit. An equally small blue dot retains the appeal. Shape, scale or surrounding space may matter without every colour being endorsed. Imagining the arrangement is enough; this preference establishes no age, sweet personality or facial feature.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我喜欢小面积圆润趣味，想比较点缀变大后是否仍喜欢。”与朋友只谈两张想象草图，不评价谁穿更年轻。可以借用跳色玩趣的亮色，却保留小尺度；即使实际不想穿，也可以保留对构思的欣赏，不需要购买或发照片。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a small rounded playful accent and asks whether a larger version remains appealing. Discuss two imagined sketches without judging who looks younger. A brighter colour can be borrowed from Colour Play while scale stays small. Enjoying the idea need not become actual wear, a purchase or a posted photograph.

The preference can concern arrangement rather than pale colour alone. A light-looking image establishes no light fabric, cool wear or easygoing life. The scene needs no changed real clothes.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我喜欢这里的留白，想比较加入一处细致收尾后的变化。”可以与安静细致的近色呼应并看，不问哪种人更清爽。听者指出自己注意到的具体区域，不替对方判断舒适或整洁；不喜欢简化后的版本，也能把细节放回。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names visual space and compares one added discreet finish. Place it beside Quiet Polish’s close-tone connections without judging which person looks fresher. A listener can name a visible area rather than decide comfort or neatness for someone else. A removed detail can return if the simpler version is unappealing.

Discretion establishes no superior status, reliability or discipline; ordinary items at different budgets can support the imagined comparison.

Actual occasion rules and comfort remain separate from imagined visual preference.
